payload._note: Ensign Group operated 297 skilled nursing and senior living facilities as of December 31, 2023, across 13 states. The 10-K provides state-level aggregated facility counts and bed/unit counts but does NOT disclose individual facility names, addresses, cities, or Medicare CCNs. State breakdown: CA (70 facilities, 6,764 SNF beds + 197 senior living units), TX (83 facilities, 9,954 SNF beds + 603 senior living units), AZ (36 facilities, 4,535 SNF beds + 731 senior living units), WI (2 facilities, 100 SNF beds), UT (21 facilities, 1,968 SNF beds + 163 senior living units), CO (25 facilities, 1,986 SNF beds + 723 senior living units), WA (16 facilities, 1,413 SNF beds + 98 senior living units), ID (12 facilities, 1,002 SNF beds + 21 senior living units), NE (7 facilities, 413 SNF beds + 341 senior living units), KS (8 facilities, 615 SNF beds + 213 senior living units), IA (6 facilities, 368 SNF beds + 31 senior living units), SC (9 facilities, 1,126 SNF beds), NV (2 facilities, 358 SNF beds). Total: 286 skilled nursing operations with 30,602 operational beds and 38 senior living operations with 3,121 units (some co-located on campus with SNFs). Subsequent to year-end, Ensign expanded into Tennessee with 2 additional SNF facilities (241 beds). No facility-level CCNs, names, or specific addresses are provided in this filing - only state-level aggregated data.
